relationships.subject: LPS-RS Ultrapure
relationships.evidence_quote: This TLR4 dependence of nociceptor sensitization by morphine is based on the finding that pretreatment with a selective TLR4 antagonist (LPS-RS Ultrapure) prevents the sensitization of nociceptors by low dose morphine.

key_findings: Low dose morphine (100 nM) reduced rheobase in human (36%) and rat (26%) small-diameter DRG neurons, an effect prevented by the TLR4 antagonist LPS-RS Ultrapure.
Supports direct action of opioids at nociceptor TLR4 as mechanism of opioid-induced hyperalgesia in humans.
